biothings.name: central precocious puberty
biothings.definition: Central precocious puberty (CPP), also referred to as gonadotropin dependent precocious puberty, is an endocrine-related developmental disease characterized by the onset of pubertal changes, with development of secondary sexual characteristics and accelerated growth and bone maturation, before the normal age of puberty (8 years in girls and 9 years in boys). [Orphanet:759]
biothings.synonyms: gonadotropin-dependant precocious puberty, gonadotropin-dependent precocious puberty, precocious puberty, central

biothings.name: peripheral precocious puberty
biothings.definition: Precocious puberty caused by sex hormones. [https://orcid.org/0000-0002-6601-2165, https://www.mayoclinic.org/diseases-conditions/precocious-puberty/symptoms-causes/syc-20351811, Wikipedia:Precocious_puberty#Peripheral]
biothings.synonyms: GIPP, gonadotropin independent precocious puberty, gonadotropin-independent precocious puberty, precocious pseudopuberty

biothings.name: central precocious puberty 1
biothings.definition: Any central precocious puberty in which the cause of the disease is a mutation in the KISS1R gene. [MONDO:patterns/disease_series_by_gene]
biothings.synonyms: central precocious puberty caused by mutation in KISS1R, KISS1R central precocious puberty, precocious puberty, central, 1, precocious puberty, central, type 1

biothings.name: precocious puberty in female
biothings.definition: A precocious puberty that involves the female organism. [MONDO:patterns/location]
biothings.synonyms: female organism precocious puberty, precocious puberty of female organism

biothings.definition: Precocious puberty that occurs in rabbit. [MONDO:patterns/nonhuman_disease]

opentargets.name: familial male-limited precocious puberty
opentargets.description: Familial male limited precocious puberty (FMPP) is a gonadotropin-independent familial form of male-limited precocious puberty, generally presenting between 2-5 years of age as accelerated growth, early development of secondary sexual characteristics and reduced adult height.
